definitions: The place to which one's spirit descends upon death, conceived as below the surface of the earth.
The locale of the spirit world or afterlife, whether deemed to be situated below the world of the living or not.

blocks.text: The underworld, also known as the netherworld or hell, is the supernatural world of the dead in various religious traditions and myths, located below the world of the living. Chthonic is the technical adjective for things of the underworld.
Netherworld is a 1992 American horror film written and directed by David Schmoeller and produced by Charles Band. The film, distributed by Full Moon Features, received mixed reviews from critics.

images.alt: Oweynagat in Rathcroghan, the entrance to the underworld in Irish mythology
